title: Sponsorship quality
description: Review agreements and historical evidence across sponsorship dossiers. Each correction stays in its owning dossier.
ownerRequired: This review is restricted to the owner.
inventoryHelp: Review dossiers, their promised services and recorded evidence. This inventory does not qualify agreements or publish content.
loadError: The inventory is unavailable. Retry the read.

read.title: Understand sponsorship quality
read.body: This workspace brings together inventories across dossiers. Reads and reviews are restricted to the owner.

choose.title: Choose a dossier to review
choose.body: Load an agreement page, then open the relevant dossier to qualify its promised services. The inventory applies no corrections.

verify.title: Review historical evidence
verify.body: Load portfolio evidence, filter findings and record an explicit conclusion. A conclusion publishes nothing and rewrites no evidence.

audit.dossierScope: Evidence shown is limited to this dossier. Portfolio counts are available in Sponsorship quality.
audit.portfolioScope: This review covers historical evidence across all dossiers.
audit.dossierCounts: {{count}} evidence item(s) matching this dossier’s criteria.
audit.pageCount: Current page: {{count}} items, up to {{limit}} per page.
audit.snapshotScope: The inventory date bounds the evidence being read. Administrative conclusions may have changed since that date. Reloading starts the first page of a new inventory.
audit.openEvidence: View this service and its evidence
audit.reviewScope: Only the latest conclusion is provided here; this view does not reproduce every earlier review.
audit.nextPageScope: The next page replaces the displayed items while keeping the same criteria and inventory date.
